hooks.command: PLUGIN_VERSION='1.0.4'; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Error: uv is required but not installed. See https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! command -v crux >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Installing crux-cli...'; if ! uv tool install crux-cli; then echo 'Error: Failed to install crux-cli.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -d "$HOME/.crux" ]; then crux init; fi; elif INSTALLED_VERSION=$(crux version 2>&1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$INSTALLED_VERSION" ] && [ "$INSTALLED_VERSION" != "$PLUGIN_VERSION" ]; then echo "Upgrading crux-cli from v${INSTALLED_VERSION} to v${PLUGIN_VERSION}..."; if ! uv tool install --force crux-cli==${PLUGIN_VERSION}; then echo "Error: Failed to upgrade crux-cli to v${PLUGIN_VERSION}. Continuing with v${INSTALLED_VERSION}." >&2; fi; fi
